content:
LifeGive Exhilarate, an aloe, amino acid herbal formula, was borne out of decades of research and clinical application concerning the positive effects that GABA protein has on those suffering from depression. When these vital nutrients can be replenished to restore proper levels, there is great potential for arresting malaise.

Suggested Use: As a dietary supplement, 2 capsules per day as recommended by your health care professional.

The Food and Drug Administration has not evaluated these statements. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

Other Ingredients: Natural Vegetable Capsules and Microcrystalline Cellulose

Many adult men and women are living with hormone imbalance. This problem may result in impaired immune function, weight gain, fat accumulation, fatigue, emotional imbalance, mood swings, decreased mental clarity and poor concentration, as well as loss of libido. Hormone Power works to optimize the body's hormone levels and create a healthier environment. The effects of hormonal repositioning may be felt in as little as two weeks for some people.

Suggested Male Use: As a dietary supplement, take 2 capsules in the morning, 1 capsule in the afternoon, and 2 capsules in the evening, for a total of 5 capsules per day.
